monkshillventures-kkday:bamboohr:738.description: 【關於 KKday】 KKday 正在加速推動全球旅遊體驗的全面革新。作為亞洲領先的旅遊體驗平台，我們致力於以數位化方式整合一站式旅遊服務，滿足旅客從靈感探索到行程完成的所有需求。目前已於全球超過 92 個國家、550 個城市，上架超過 30 萬個精選體驗行程。近年來更拓展至商城經營與 SaaS 服務，逐步打造完整的旅遊體驗生態圈。 我們相信，好的視覺不只是好看，而是能讓體驗更有溫度、讓價值被看見，並真正推動轉換與成長。如果你希望你的設計不只是「被交付」，而是能參與定義問題、影響商業成果，這個角色會很適合你。 【工作內容｜你將實際投入的事情】 本角色隸屬於 Global Marketing Design Team, 以行銷視覺設計為核心（約 70–80%），並逐步參與品牌視覺優化與設計規範的建立。 行銷視覺與活動設計（核心） 設計行銷活動視覺，包含活動網頁（Landing Page）、主視覺、社群素材與數位廣告 與行銷團隊密切合作，理解活動目標與用戶輪廓，將商業需求轉化為具轉換力的視覺表 思考版型結構、視覺層級與溝通重點，而不只是單純產出素材 實體活動與跨渠道視覺 負責旅展與線下實體活動的整體視覺設計 確保品牌在不同媒介（線上 / 線下）與裝置中呈現一致、專業且具辨識度的形象 創意發想與設計提案 參與行銷與專案前期討論，主動提出設計觀點與創意方向 能清楚說明設計決策背後的思考邏輯，並在美感與商業目標之間取得平衡 設計規範與品質維護 協助建立與優化設計規範（Design Guideline） 讓設計不只是一次性的產出，而是能被延續、被複用、被放大影響力 【你是誰｜Who You Are】 我們在找的不是只會執行的設計師，而是願意思考、能對結果負責的成熟設計者。 主動釐清需求、善於溝通 你不只接需求，而是會問「為什麼要做」、「真正的目標是什麼」 能結構化表達設計決策 你可以清楚說明設計如何回應商業目標、用戶情境與品牌定位 具備跨裝置與基礎 UI/UX 理解 了解 RWD、基本 HTML / CSS 概念，能判斷不同裝置下的視覺差異與限制 具即戰力的資深設計經驗 擁有紮實的設計基礎、成熟的判斷力，能獨立完成專案並掌握品質 對旅遊或電商產業有敏感度 理解用戶行為與產業邏輯，能把設計放在更大的商業脈絡中思考 持續學習，對新工具保持開放心態 並思考如何將其應用於實際專案中，提升產能與設計品質，有實際使用 AI 工具完成設計案例者佳（例如生成素材、排版輔助、Prototying等） 【必要技能與經驗】 熟悉多元視覺風格，能依活動需求彈性調整設計表現 精通 Adobe、Figma 並能建立可重複使用的視覺元件與版型 具備社群素材、數位廣告、基礎影音或修圖相關製作經驗者佳 細心、具責任感，能在快節奏環境中穩定產出 具專案管理或帶領經驗者佳，能有效掌控時程並與跨部門合作 【加分條件】 曾參與大型行銷活動、年度檔期或品牌視覺專案 能從數據或成效回饋中，調整與優化設計方向 具跨市場、跨語系或 Global Campaign 視覺設計經驗者佳 請務必附上作品集，以利內部進行後續審核，謝謝！

monkshillventures-ninja-van:lever:6c6838.title: Senior Executive, Demand & Supply Planning
monkshillventures-ninja-van:lever:6c6838.description: The Senior Executive, Demand & Planning (Supply Chain) is responsible for managing demand forecasting, inventory planning, replenishment, and inbound supply operations to ensure optimal stock availability and business continuity. This role works closely with Sales, Commercial, principals, and supply chain partners to balance customer demand with supply capabilities, minimize inventory risks, and support business growth through effective planning, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain rolling demand forecasts of up to 18 months at SKU and aggregate levels using historical sales trends, market intelligence, and commercial inputs.

Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Commercial teams, and principals to incorporate latest promotion plans, new launches, customer plans, competitive activities, and market trends into forecast assumptions.
Lead forecast building blocks for new product launches and establish baseline forecasts for regular product ranges.
Plan & raise purchase orders based on demand forecasts, inventory levels, and replenishment requirements.
Liaise with principals and brand PICs to confirm stock availability, shipment schedules, and delivery timelines.
Ensure purchase orders are processed accurately, timely, and in accordance with internal SOPs.
Reconcile supply plans against demand forecasts to identify and mitigate stock shortages, excess inventory, and supply risks.
Coordinate with principals, suppliers, warehouse teams, and external supply chain partners to ensure timely inbound replenishment.
Monitor inbound shipments & delivery schedules to ensure stock arrivals & operational requirements align.
Resolve shipment discrepancies, short deliveries, and documentation-related issues promptly.
Ensure timely and accurate goods receiving (GRN) processes and maintain complete inbound documentation records.
Maintain accurate inbound and inventory records within DMS/WMS systems.
Act as the key point of contact and subject matter expert for Commercial and Sales teams regarding inbound order fulfilment and stock availability.
Align with internal stakeholders on stock arrival timelines to support business activities, promotions, and customer demand.
Communicate stock risks, shipment delays, and operational challenges to stakeholders in a timely manner.
Analyze business risks and opportunities and jointly propose mitigation or recovery plans with relevant stakeholders.
Coordinate with external supply chain partners & logistics providers to ensure smooth operational execution.
Monitor inventory levels and maintain sufficient stock coverage across warehouses.
Track inbound replenishment closely to prevent stock shortages, overstocks, and slow-moving inventory.
Identify aging, damaged, excess, or non-moving inventory and recommend clearance or write-off actions where necessary.
Prepare ad hoc inventory, replenishment, and operational reports/documentation as required.
qualifications: Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
Minimum 3–5 years of experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Inventory Planning, Procurement, or FMCG Distribution.
Strong experience in demand forecasting, inventory management, replenishment planning, and purchase order management.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis, forecasting, and reporting.
Familiarity with ERP, DMS, and WMS systems is an advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify supply risks and recommend solutions.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Commercial, Operations, and external partners.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and adapt to changing business requirements.
High attention to detail and accuracy when handling inventory, purchase orders, and operational data.
